d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director, Issuing VAS Specialist Seller, KBO, to join the broader Value-Added Services Sales organization. Based in Riyadh, the role is responsible for driving the sale and commercialization of non-risk Issuing Value-Added Services across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Oman.

The portfolio focus includes Loyalty, Digital, Network and Processing solutions, together with other non-risk Issuing VAS solutions introduced over time. This includes capabilities that help clients design and operate loyalty programs, create differentiated digital cardholder experiences, modernize issuer connectivity and processing, and improve portfolio commercialization. The role covers banks, fintechs, processors and relevant ecosystem partners and combines consultative selling, technical credibility, commercial leadership and executive engagement.
Loyalty and customer engagement: Loyalty management and program operations, rewards and redemption, card-linked and merchant-funded offers, campaign management, personalization.
Digital issuing and issuer experiences: Digital card lifecycle, issuer app integration, mobile and web enablement, digital self-service, customer journeys, APIs and SDKs.
Network and processing: Issuer processing, connectivity and integration, transaction and portfolio services, processing modernization and operational enablement.

Understanding of issuer business models and familiarity with relevant solution families, including loyalty management and program operations, card-linked offers, digital issuer experiences, APIs and SDKs, and network or issuer-processing services.

Strong commercial, negotiation, presentation and written communication skills.
Ability to connect technical solution capabilities to measurable client outcomes and compelling business cases.
Highly collaborative working style, with the ability to navigate cross-functional and matrixed organizations.
Strong self-management, prioritization and forecasting discipline, with the drive to achieve goals with limited oversight.
Multicultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Oman and the wider GCC.
Ability and willingness to travel regularly across the assigned markets.
r: Develop and execute market and account sales plans for non-risk Issuing VAS solutions across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Oman.
Build, qualify and continuously manage a healthy opportunity pipeline, with accountability for bookings, new revenue, growth of existing revenue and revenue realization.

Drive achievement of assigned Issuing VAS pipeline, bookings and revenue objectives across the KBO markets.
Acquire new clients and expand existing relationships through coordinated account planning and disciplined opportunity management.
Understand complex client requirements and position appropriate Visa capabilities in collaboration with solution and product specialists.
Champion Visa’s value-based sales methodology and develop mutual success plans that connect client outcomes to commercialization and revenue realization.
Coordinate internal approvals and contributions required to create viable technical, commercial, contractual and implementation propositions.
Support successful post-sale transition while retaining active ownership of commercialization progress and revenue outcomes.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first.
